title: Auto-refund a damaged order under policy
narrative: An ORDER_PLACED event arrives, immediately followed by ORDER_PAID. The customer reports the package arrived damaged. The agent checks the policy (under $100, within 30 days, eligible reason), and decides to auto-refund without escalating to a human. The receipt below is the tamper-evident proof of that decision.

steps.description: Ingest an ORDER_PLACED event so the refund runtime tracks the order.
Mark the order paid (low-risk, no approval). Moves the order CREATED → PAID.
Run AUTO_REFUND under the agent's policy. Decision signed and anchored.
